title: in-toto Statement v1
description: An in-toto attestation Statement as https://github.com/in-toto/attestation/blob/main/spec/v1/statement.md defines it (checked 2026-10-17): _type, at least one subject with a digest, the predicate's type and the predicate. Written for Repro's exports (H04); Repro's predicate is reproduction-card-v0.schema.json. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know (the spec's parsing rules), so no object here forbids others.

subject.description: What the attestation is about. Each element MUST have digest set.

predicateType.description: A TypeURI (RFC 3986) naming the predicate's type; it should resolve to its description and carry its major version.

DigestSet.description: Algorithm name to digest, e.g. sha256 or gitCommit in lowercase hex.

ResourceDescriptor.description: A resource or artifact: at least one of uri, digest or content.
